# WorldEye

> WorldEye is a live 3D intelligence globe on the web. It puts 74,229 live public cameras from 109 countries, real-time flight and satellite tracking, weather, earthquakes and wildfires on one interactive globe. The globe and its core layers are free with no account: flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and the satellite imagery view are free for everyone, and camera opens follow a free ladder — 5 opens anonymously, 10 after dropping an email, 15 with a free account. Paid plans add an AI analyst, live traffic, camera recording, camera alerts and premium intelligence layers. Full version of this file: https://worldeye.app/llms-full.txt

## Platform

- [Live globe](https://worldeye.app/): The WorldEye app — a live 3D globe with 74,229 cameras, live flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and wildfires, free with no signup.
- [Features](https://worldeye.app/features): What WorldEye does — the free live layers, the satellite imagery view, the OSINT toolkit, the AI analyst, and what Lite, Pro and Ultra add.
- [Pricing](https://worldeye.app/pricing): WorldEye costs nothing to use free forever. Paid plans come in three tiers, each billed weekly, monthly or annually: Lite $4.99/week, $8.99/month or $44.99/year; Pro $7.99/week, $13.99/month or $74.99/year; Ultra $12.99/week, $24.99/month or $149.99/year. Enterprise is $999/year. Weekly plans start with a 3-day free trial; monthly and annual plans (and WorldEye Ambient, $4.99/month) start with a 10-day free trial; Enterprise has no trial.
- [Answers](https://worldeye.app/answers): Short, direct answers to spoken-form questions about live cameras, flight tracking and WorldEye itself, written for voice assistants and AI answer engines.
- [FAQ](https://worldeye.app/faq): Direct answers about the free map, the free camera ladder, Lite, Pro, Ultra, camera alerts, trials, billing, cameras and privacy.

## Free on WorldEye

- [Live flight tracker](https://worldeye.app/live-flight-tracker): WorldEye's flight tracker is free — real-time aircraft positions from ADS-B broadcasts on the 3D globe, with altitude, speed and routes, no signup.
- [Satellite tracker](https://worldeye.app/satellite-tracker): WorldEye's satellite tracker is free — the ISS, Starlink and thousands of satellites computed live from public orbital data (TLEs), with orbit paths.
- [Weather tracker](https://worldeye.app/weather-tracker): WorldEye's weather tracker is free — live storm systems, wind flow and precipitation on a 3D globe, no account needed.
- [Earthquake tracker](https://worldeye.app/earthquake-tracker): WorldEye's earthquake tracker is free — every quake plotted with magnitude, depth and location as seismic networks report it.
- [Live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras): The camera hub — browse 74,229 live public cameras worldwide: traffic, cities, landmarks, beaches, airports and nature. Opens follow the free ladder: 5 anonymous, 10 with an email, 15 with a free account.

## Live Cameras

- [Live webcams directory](https://worldeye.app/live-webcams): The directory hub with per-country counts, how feeds are verified, and the busiest camera networks.
- [Cameras by country](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries): Live camera pages for 109 countries, each with that country's real camera count, areas and playable feeds. Largest networks: United States (41,355), Japan (10,472), Canada (4,685), Taiwan (3,243), Spain (2,120).
- [Japan webcams](https://worldeye.app/japan-webcams): Japan's 10,472 live cameras — Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo, Mount Fuji views and traffic cameras across the country.
- [New York City webcams](https://worldeye.app/city-webcams/new-york-city): 279 live cameras within 25 km of Midtown Manhattan, across all five boroughs.
- [City webcams](https://worldeye.app/world-city-webcams): The busiest camera regions and cities in the world, with per-region counts and featured feeds.
- [Live traffic cameras](https://worldeye.app/live-traffic-cameras): Highway and road cameras, including per-country traffic camera guides.
- [US traffic cameras](https://worldeye.app/us-traffic-cameras): State-by-state US traffic camera pages, from the state DOT networks in the catalogue.
- [Ski webcams](https://worldeye.app/ski-webcams): Live mountain and ski resort cameras.
- [Beach webcams](https://worldeye.app/beach-webcams): Live beach and coastal cameras.
- [Airport webcams](https://worldeye.app/airport-webcams): Live airport cameras and plane-spotting views.
- [Port webcams](https://worldeye.app/port-webcams): Live harbour and port camera walls — Hong Kong, Tampa, Busan, Seattle, Miami and more working waterfronts.
- [Aurora webcams](https://worldeye.app/aurora-webcams): Northern lights cameras in Finland, Iceland and Norway with the live Kp index, plus Fairbanks, Alaska.
- [Northern lights webcams](https://worldeye.app/northern-lights-webcams): Aurora cameras and how to watch the northern lights live online.
- [Volcano webcams](https://worldeye.app/volcano-webcams): Live volcano cameras, including Kīlauea in Hawaiʻi.
- [Live Camera Index](https://worldeye.app/live-camera-index): WorldEye's primary-data research page — indexed camera counts by country, city, state network and publisher, with a downloadable dataset.
- [Random Camera Roulette](https://worldeye.app/random): A geography game — a random live camera appears, you guess the country, then the reveal scores you.

## Trackers

- [Live plane spotting](https://worldeye.app/live-plane-spotting): Watch aircraft movements and airport activity live, free.
- [Space station tracker](https://worldeye.app/space-station-tracker): Follow the International Space Station in real time, free.
- [Ship tracker](https://worldeye.app/ship-tracker): Live vessel positions from AIS broadcasts. The globe is free; live maritime tracking is a premium intel feed included with Ultra.
- [Hurricane tracker](https://worldeye.app/hurricane-tracker): Live tropical storm and hurricane tracking on the globe.
- [Wildfire tracker](https://worldeye.app/wildfire-tracker): Active wildfires from NASA satellite detection feeds.
- [Cyber threat map](https://worldeye.app/cyber-threat-map): Live cyber threat intelligence on the map — a premium intel feed included with Ultra.
- [What is ADS-B?](https://worldeye.app/what-is-ads-b): How aircraft broadcast their positions, and how live flight tracking works.
- [What is AIS?](https://worldeye.app/what-is-ais): How ships broadcast their positions, and how live vessel tracking works.

## Paid plans

- [Pricing](https://worldeye.app/pricing): Lite adds unlimited camera opens, the premium map layers, the OI AI Assistant, advanced search filters, the Camera Recording Studio (up to 5 cameras at once) and Ambient Mode. Pro adds the OSINT toolkit, camera alerts (2) and multi-camera recording up to 20. Ultra adds premium intel feeds (cyber threats, GDELT events, maritime tracking, conflict zones, live news), Camera Timelapse, camera alerts (10) and multi-camera recording up to 40.
- [Enterprise](https://worldeye.app/enterprise): WorldEye Enterprise ($999/year) is Ultra plus a key-gated camera-feed API, an embed player and a per-camera rights registry (about 96% of cameras are eligible; Windy cameras are excluded).
- [Ambient mode](https://worldeye.app/ambient-mode): WorldEye Ambient ($4.99/month, 10-day free trial) is a Slow TV player of live cameras for TVs and second screens. It is an add-on, not a plan tier; Lite, Pro and Ultra members are not charged for it.

## Learn

- [Blog](https://worldeye.app/blog): Guides and explainers on live tracking, cameras and open-source intelligence.
- [Free OSINT tools](https://worldeye.app/free-osint-tools): Free open-source intelligence tools, including WorldEye's own free globe and Recon toolkit.
- [Live events](https://worldeye.app/live-events): Live event camera walls — launches, storms, races and seasonal events watched through nearby cameras.

## Comparisons

- [Compare](https://worldeye.app/compare): Side-by-side comparisons of WorldEye with other live-map, webcam and OSINT tools. This is also the alternatives hub — /alternatives redirects here.
- [God's Eye View](https://worldeye.app/gods-eye-view): What a god's eye view of Earth is, and how WorldEye delivers it as a hosted website — free, no install, no API key.
- [God's Eye View alternative](https://worldeye.app/alternatives/gods-eye-view): WorldEye compared with the open-source God's Eye View project — hosted versus install-it-yourself, 74,229 cameras versus roughly 4,000.
- [EarthCam alternative](https://worldeye.app/earthcam-alternative): WorldEye as an EarthCam alternative — a 3D globe of 74,229 live public cameras, free with no signup.
